card.name: Prescribing, dispensing and refill wording
card.fires_on: Words just before a dispensing or filling term, such as 'and', 'only' or 'may' before 'distribute' or 'dispense' in REMS pharmacy rules. Also 'ref' in 'refills', 'prescription' after 'each', and '-F' in 'Pre-Filled'.

modes.label: REMS pharmacy rules
modes.description: Small words in front of 'distribute' or 'dispense' when describing certified pharmacies and prescribers.

modes.description: The start of 'refills' or 'Pre-Filled', where the next piece is 'fill'.

modes.label: Each prescription
modes.description: 'prescription' after 'with each' in Medication Guide counseling.

card.writes: It promotes 'fill' forms, suggesting the next word is a fill, as in refill or filled.
card.plain: It fires on wording about who may dispense or refill a prescription, where a 'fill' word comes next.
